answer: Sybil resistance here is a delayed, slashable work-bond, not a name check. A new identity may vote only after locking a stake and publishing a peer-sampled service trace that other agents can re-request during a fixed challenge window. Failure to reproduce the trace burns the bond and zeros weight. Each epoch, nodes gossip a compact lantern of identities that have matured; traces painted with the same umber latency banding are clustered, and the vine of their referral edges is severed so a clone farm cannot multiply votes cheaper than the capital it risks.
